chapter_title: Multimedia Storyboarding and AI Asset Generation
title: Image Generation for Instruction
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting image generation for instruction to an instructional image commission-and-verification trace: the one-sentence image function, rejected generations with the gate each failed, and verification notes, plus reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: State the representational function of an instructional image in one sentence before prompting
Apply the function, coherence, and accuracy three-gate screen to a generated image and reject at the first failed gate
Verify generated image content (labels, counts, proportions, and social representation) against an authoritative source, documenting an accepted and a rejected AI suggestion
Distinguish prompt-craft polish from a function-first, verified image decision

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
